verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken leaderboard layout. The rotated URL is a microscopic, unreadable sliver. The product list is tiny and jammed against the right edge, with a large dead gap between the stripes and the list. The signature full-height colour stripes have shrunk to a small icon, so the brand feel is lost. In B, 'for all drinkware on' is set nearly as large as the price, so it competes with it, and it almost touches the stripe graphic. A keeps a gap there and a clearer price-first hierarchy, so it is marginally better.
